prescriptive_measures.measure_name: Electronically Commutated Motor (ECM) – Refrigeration Fan
prescriptive_measures.baseline_equipment: Standard PSC or shaded-pole evaporator fan motor
prescriptive_measures.replacement_equipment: Electronically commutated motor (ECM) ≥66% electrical motor efficiency
prescriptive_measures.notes: ECM must have electrical motor efficiency of at least 66%. Typically applied to refrigerated case evaporator fan motors.

prescriptive_measures.program_name: Express Energy Solutions (2025)
prescriptive_measures.measure_name: Refrigerated Display Case Upgrade/Controls
prescriptive_measures.baseline_equipment: Standard open refrigerated display case without efficiency controls
prescriptive_measures.replacement_equipment: Refrigerated display case with energy efficiency controls or upgrade
prescriptive_measures.notes: Newly constructed refrigerated and cooled spaces not eligible. Rebates same for early retirement or replacement on burnout.

prescriptive_measures.program_name: Express Energy Solutions (2025)
prescriptive_measures.measure_name: Walk-in Cooler/Freezer Strip Curtain
prescriptive_measures.baseline_equipment: Walk-in cooler or freezer door opening without infiltration barrier
prescriptive_measures.replacement_equipment: Strip curtain installed at walk-in cooler/freezer opening
prescriptive_measures.notes: Strip curtains must be installed in areas without existing infiltration barrier. Newly constructed spaces not eligible.

prescriptive_measures.program_name: Express Energy Solutions (2025)
prescriptive_measures.measure_name: Walk-in Cooler/Freezer Automatic Door Closer
prescriptive_measures.baseline_equipment: Walk-in cooler or freezer door without automatic closer
prescriptive_measures.replacement_equipment: Automatic door closer installed on walk-in cooler/freezer
prescriptive_measures.notes: Auto closers must be installed on doors without existing auto closer. Newly constructed spaces not eligible.
